dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards the posterior peduncle, forming a smooth parabolic curve terminating in a sharp point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Primarily smooth lateral margins with minor bilateral symmetry; slight inward curvature observed anterior to the mid-section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with subtle light-grey tonal variations across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey shading localized around the nuchal region and along the central dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Highly diffuse; gradients between light-grey shaded areas and the primary white baseline are gradual with no sharp borders.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several faint, linear, longitudinal scars are visible on the mid-dorsal surface; one small, circular high-contrast white spot located on the left-posterior quadrant.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep circular indentation at the blowhole site; visible longitudinal elevation along the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint parallel rake marks on the upper dorsal area; minor superficial scratches.
